material.source: https://store.bblcdn.eu/s8/default/a64af9edb0f64095ad18bc4ad4faf1ec/Bambu_PA6-CF_Technical_Data_Sheet-v2.pdf (Technical Data Sheet V3.0, ISO 527 / ISO 1183, specimens 100 % infill, annealed and dried 80 C 12 h)

assumptions.nu_xz: 0.30 not in the TDS (load in the layer plane, contraction along Z)
assumptions.g_z_mpa: E_z/(2(1+nu)), interlayer shear modulus not in the TDS
assumptions.state: dry, annealed, 100 % infill; no moisture, voids, plasticity, fatigue or strain rate

mass.model: frame: exact mesh volume integrals x density; components: homogeneous boxes (props: discs) with parallel-axis theorem about the total centre of mass

airflow.method: top-view silhouette of the winding-number voxel grid; prop share = material inside the four prop discs / disc area, ring share excludes the motor hub radius

assembly.method: holes from an exact plane section rasterised at the section voxel; reachability = 9 parallel rays (axis plus screw-head or connector radius) from the hole or connector along the tool axis must not re-enter material beyond the tool skip distance (the pad itself); fit = material voxels inside each keep-out shrunk by one voxel

printability.method: faces whose normal lies within 45 deg of straight down above the bed, area share of the surface

form.method: widths 2 x EDT on the 3D skeleton minus one voxel; section ratio = vertical material run / in-plane width at each skeleton voxel (> 1 upright, < 1 flat)

loops.method: first Betti number b1 = b0 + b2 - chi of the voxel solid after a morphological closing that fills bores and slots up to 2 x the closing radius

symmetry.method: surface samples mirrored at x = mean motor x, distance to the original surface

roughness.method: Cohen-Steiner/Morvan mean curvature measure of each ball around evenly sampled surface points divided by the disc area pi r^2 (sphere 1/R, cylinder 1/(2R), plane 0); RMS of the |H| differences of sample pairs closer than 1.5 r; independent of the triangulation, record only

walls.method: Winding-number voxelisation at h; exact EDT opening with a ball of the radius (erosion EDT >= r, dilation EDT <= r) tiled along x with halo; removed voxels grouped with 26-connectivity; deep components reach the depth below the original surface (true walls under 2 r), shallow ones are edge rounding
walls.status: Provisional: calibrated on the ManaFly 3 BETA V4 manufacturer geometry (no own test); final after own drop tests in M2

sources.arm_tip: motor thrust 1.80 N (GTS V3 1203 8000KV, GF65R, 7.4 V) x 2, upward on the front-left motor seat, centre mounts fixed
sources.crash_front: all-up mass 125 g x 25 g = 30.6 N rearward on the camera region, centre mounts fixed
sources.crash_arm: all-up mass 125 g x 12.5 g = 15.3 N on the front-left motor seat, oblique (inward, tangential, downward 2:2:1 normalised), centre mounts fixed
sources.crash_back: ASSUMPTION: all-up mass 125 g x 12.5 g = 15.3 N on the battery deck towards the frame (landing on the back), four motor seats fixed
sources.safety_factor: 2.0 against TDS tensile strength, linear static equivalent load, no impact dynamics

support.modes: four motor seat undersides fixed (all translations), battery as rigidly coupled point mass on the deck band

slicer.profile: PrusaSlicer built-in defaults (generic FFF printer, default speeds) with nozzle 0.4, layer 0.2 mm, 2 perimeters, 15 % infill, automatic supports on a 256 x 256 x 256 mm bed
